text.en:
There is hereby established, under the
supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school
in Barangay Lacaron, Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao
Occidental, to be known as Lacaron National High School.
•
SEc. 2. The Secretary of Education shall immediately
include in the Department's program the operationalization of
the Lacaron National High School, the funding of which shall be
included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

2

Within sixty (60) days from the approval of
this Act, the Secretary of Education shall promulgate the rules
and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
SEc. 4. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general
circulation.
